payload.evidence: CODE AND RAN AND OBSERVED, answered from harness source by snorkeltoast at vc's request rather than inferred from FLOORS.md's output -- the distinction the row turns on, since a clean table cannot show whether a guard exists. control_blocked() folds absent, unprovable, undecided and ungradeable into one blocked set, and grade_per_slide never grades a blocked slide. In the run behind FLOORS.md, slide 1 printed "b slide 1 RMSE 0.000000" and was EXCLUDED, under a heading naming "3 covered slide(s) are NOT gradeable" and a closing note that a green here does not cover them and that the reasons are not all the same reason. So the exact artefact this row exists to refuse -- a per-slide zero over a frame that did not contain the slide's content -- was produced and refused as evidence in the same run, by name. Slide 1's clean zero is the measured instance: its captured frame holds the sunburst ground and wordmark chrome and none of the venue, city, date or action, because the crawl text has not entered frame at that capture phase. CORROBORATED AT snorkeltoast 28b4127, AND THE EARLIER CITATION IS DELIBERATELY REPLACED RATHER THAN KEPT. vc first cited redproof2.log's "3 not-gradeable slide(s) were excluded by name rather than tolerated" as corroboration. THAT CITATION DID NOT CORROBORATE WHAT IT WAS QUOTED FOR: that run used a control with no min_defect, so slides 13 and 14 were excluded as UNDECIDED -- a reason unrelated to this row's presence-and-content mechanism -- and only one of the three exclusions was on point. A count of three that happened to include the case is weaker evidence than a count of one that IS the case, and vc quoted the three.
